patch.summary:
Choose Foxit only if your buying job matches “PDF Editor adjacent productivity tool — PDF Editor ~$129.99/user/year (~$10.83/mo); free R” rather than Office Timeline's shape. Choose Office Timeline only if your buying job matches “PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite fro” rather than Foxit's shape. Workflow advantage: Foxit leans document-productivity; Office Timeline leans timeline-reporting, project-tracking. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

- Positioning: Foxit is PDF Editor adjacent productivity tool — PDF Editor ~$129.99/user/year (~$10.83/mo); free Reader.; Office Timeline is PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite from $9/user/mo annual..

- Workflow coverage skew: Foxit-leaning document-productivity vs Office Timeline-leaning timeline-reporting, project-tracking.
